Mountain Shaper

Mountain Shaper is one of the Adepti of the south — illuminated beasts who received their title from the Prime of Adepti, Morax. Mountain Shaper was among the first Adepti to sign the contract with Rex Lapis and swear to protect the people; thus, he was protecting Guili Assembly dwellers together with the other Adepti and helped them with the relocation to the harbor when the flood occurred. During the Archon War, Mountain Shaper was summoned by the Lord of Geo to protect Liyue. After the Archon War ended 3,700 years ago, the Liyue Harbor was founded, and the Adepti of the south swore to protect it.

Currently, he lives in Jueyun Karst, his abode is located on Mt. Hulao, and his power stems from both inner enlightenment and external knowledge. The way to the abode is obstructed by amber traps, which careless travelers often fall into. The amber is produced by a flower that one has planted here, called the karst crawler. The majority of the plant is hidden underground. When stepped on, it produces amber to trap the invader. After taking up residence here, Mountain Shaper planted many karst crawlers to ensure that the tranquility of the mountain would remain undisturbed. Once, seeking to end the disturbance, Mountain Shaper sealed Qiqi, a maiden who was accidentally killed during the Adepti and demons' war. She was awakened later, but went into a berserk state, being unable to control Adeptal energy running in her, so the amber trap seemed the only solution. After hundreds of years, Qiqi was discovered by humans, still trapped in the amber, and was brought to Wangsheng Funeral Parlor for burial. The mountain roads were treacherous, however, and the amber was bumped about. Coupled with the passing of many years, the seal on Qiqi was all but spent. She awakened in the middle of the night, broke the amber in secret, and fled.

After defeating all the gods in Liyue during the Archon War,
ascended to the divine throne and received the Geo Gnosis, becoming the Geo Archon. Together with the Adepti, he ruled the country of contracts, and soon Liyue became a major trading nation. 3,700 years after the beginning of his reign, Morax decided to pass the rule of Liyue to the Adepti and the people, leaving the post of an Archon. He played out his death in front of the people of the region and entered into "a contract to end all contracts" with the Cryo Archon. In his performance, Morax orchestrated the death of Geo Archon during one of the Rites of Descension. Upon learning of the incident, the Adepti were furious, believing that the Qixing, Liyue's rulers, had failed in their task and allowed the Archon's death. When Mountain Shaper met Traveler and Paimon and found out about the assassination of the Lord of Geo on the Rite of Descension, he was outraged. The Adeptus was disappointed in the Liyue Qixing since they allowed the killing to happen and then blamed the citizens. Since Moon Carver had already summoned him, he headed to the meeting to discuss the future of Liyue.

While Liyue lay unprotected, the Eleventh Fatui Harbinger, Tartaglia, decided to provoke the Lord of Geo. Childe didn’t believe in the Geo Archon's demise and resurrected one of the gods who perished during the Archon War, the Overlord of the Vortex, Osial, to force Rex Lapis to come to the defense of his people. This was how the Harbinger intended to obtain the Geo Gnosis. When Osial was awakened and began to threaten Liyue, Adepti, including Mountain Shaper, united with the Liyue Qixing to protect the harbor. Together they defeated Osial and sent him back beneath the Guyun Stone Forest. After Rex Lapis appeared to the Adepti in a dream and told them of his plan, they agreed to entrust Qixing with the management of Liyue.

One day at the Lantern Rite Mountain Shaper, together with Rex Lapis and Moon Carver, borrowed the mechanism to cook food from Cloud Retainer and spent the evening making food. Despite using their friend’s invention, Mountain Shaper and Moon Carver don’t understand Cloud Retainer's love for the mechanisms and haute cuisine.

customize.text: Vibrant Harriers Aloft in Spring Breeze

Mountain Shaper and Moon Carver visited Liyue Harbor during the Lantern Rite to meet with Cloud Retainer. They disguised themselves as mortals, Houzhang and Jiehu, so that people would not recognize them. The Traveler and Paimon initially mistook the Adepti for Treasure Hoarders, and they had to prove they were illuminated beasts. Mountain Shaper said he had once come to the harbor to collect karst crawlers' seeds, and the young people of Liyue were pestering him. In the end, Streetward Rambler had to save her friend. He also said that he borrows a cooking machine from Cloud Retainer and cooks food, hiding the machine whenever he sees the Adepti.
During Cloud Retainer's kite-flying master class on Mt. Aocang, the Moon Carver and Mountain Shaper were flying a kite on a nearby mountain. The kite accidentally ended up on Mt. Aocang, and they had to meet Cloud Retainer, who immediately recognized them as old friends. Later, the Adepti participated in Cloud Retainer's plan to help a young man from Chenyu Vale, Gaming, reunite with his father. They pretended to be the Treasure Hoarders and distracted Gaming while the Traveler and Paimon followed the plan and took Gaming's father away.

At the Lantern Rite, which honored the memory of the deceased Yaksha, Menogias, Mountain Shaper and Moon Carver recalled that as a master of handicrafts, it would not have been difficult for Menogias to create kites. If he was still alive, he could have opened his own kite shop, which would have brought him not only great profit but also even greater respect. And if Menogias, as before, did not dare to get involved in human affairs, he could have entrusted the sale of kites to them. Thus, while thinking about how they would celebrate their success together in wonderful company with a bottle of wine, the Adepti were filled with happy memories and enjoyed the beauty of the harbor beyond Menogias.

customize.text: A Lanternlit Ode to the Silver Moon

Shortly before the Lantern Rite dedicated to the White Horse Adeptus, people saw an unusual phenomenon in the sky: the moon was obscured by a black shadow, as if a piece had been bitten off. This phenomenon was caused by the real moon appearing in the sky of Teyvat, and the projection of the moon, which had hung there for six thousand years, began to disappear. When this process occurred, people saw the moon being obscured by a black shadow. When it stopped, the black shadow disappeared, becoming invisible to the naked eye. The false moon held a fragment of the White Horse Adeptus's soul, and if the false moon disintegrated, the soul would disappear with it. Rex Lapis decided to take advantage of this moment to rescue the White Horse Adeptus. To do so, he, the Traveler, and Paimon set out to find the other two soul fragments of the Lord of Geo's old friend. Furthermore, Morax instructed all the Adepti to keep a close watch on Liyue Harbor. He didn't want to endanger them by recounting the events of ancient times, so he didn't explain the situation.

When Mountain Shaper and Moon Carver were ordered to rush to Liyue Harbor to keep watch, Mountain Shaper decided to tend to the mint he and Moon Carver had planted. When the mint became infected with diseases and parasites, Moon Carver transplanted them to Mt. Hulao, but Cloud Retainer didn't appreciate such compassion for the plants and angrily banished both Adepti to the desert. When they finally returned to the harbor, they saw their old acquaintance, Gaming, and the Treasure Hoarders. It turned out that it wasn't Gaming who was in danger, but the Treasure Hoarders themselves. Gaming was pursuing them to become his disciples in the Wushou Dance, and he wouldn't take no for an answer. Upon closer inspection, the Adepti noticed the boy was possessed. The Traveler and Paimon came to their aid, going after Gaming, knowing that he had been possessed by one of the White Horse Adeptus’s Deadly Selves. Provoked, the Deadly Self was forced to leave the dancer's body and possess Mountain Shaper. Under the influence of the possession, the Adeptus decided to fulfill his greatest desire: to sow mint in Cloud Retainer's abode to anger her.

While Mountain Shaper was planting the mint, the other Adepti devised a plan to lure out the White Horse Adeptus's Deadly Self. They decided to seal off the exits from Mt. Aocang, and the Traveler would be the only one into whom the Deadly Self could possess. But due to their strength, they would be able to resist this and speak with the White Horse Adeptus. When, upon meeting the Traveler, the Deadly Self agreed to surrender the fragment of the White Horse Adeptus's soul contained within her, Mountain Shaper awoke from his possession, surrounded by mint. He had no memory of the event and believed the mint had been planted by the Traveler themselves. And although the Adeptus acted under the influence of the Deadly Self, he could not escape Cloud Retainer's wrath.
